title: Synthesize traffic mosaics and stability anchors for CI latency gating
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Our current CI perf gates rely on a small set of golden runs that do not capture interactions between kernel selection, attention optimizations, and prefill/decode scheduling. That leads to intermittent regressions slipping through when workload composition shifts (e.g., short-chat bursts vs long-prefill batches).

Goal: Create a deterministic workload generator ("traffic mosaic"), a set of stability anchors (deterministic golden seeds with tolerance envelopes), and CI integration that fails when key latency/cost metrics deviate beyond allowed thresholds. The mosaics should represent mixtures of microprofiles (short 1-2 token turns), prefill-heavy flows, long-context decodes, and mixed-batch concurrency, exercised across kernel-routing variants and attention opt flags.

Why this matters: We need CI-level signal that catches regressions stemming from kernel routing heuristics, attention kernel changes (e.g., flash attention variants), and prefill/decoder pacing logic before they reach staging/production. The approach should be reproducible locally and fast enough to run in nightly CI with selectable golden baselines for faster PR checks.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic 'traffic mosaic' generator that emits a workload tarball and a reproducible seed for CI runs
At least five distinct mosaic compositions (micros, prefill-heavy, long-context, bursty chat, mixed-concurrency) documented and checked in
A stability anchor set (golden seeds) with measured baselines for p50/p95/p99 latency and tokens/s across flagship models (gpt-like-7b, opt-style-13b) on two hardware profiles
CI perf gate that compares run metrics against golden anchors and fails if p95 latency regresses > 6% or tokens/s drops > 5% or kernel-selection distribution shifts beyond tolerated bounds
Automation scripts to replay a mosaic locally and in CI with environment knobs (kernel routing flags, attention opt toggles, prefill-parallelism)
Runbook describing how to add/remove mosaics, update golden baselines, and triage CI failures
tasks: Design mosaic taxonomy and select representative microprofiles (owner: Marcelo)
Implement workload generator that emits deterministic request sequences and KV-prefill scenarios (owner: Eng-Infra)
Add telemetry hooks to capture per-request kernel selection, attention kernel tag, prefill/decode duration breakdowns (owner: Telemetry)
Run golden baseline collection on two hardware variants and store metrics in artifacts bucket (owner: SRE)
Implement CI comparator job and threshold logic; wire to nightly pipeline with artifact caching (owner: CI)
Create developer-facing CLI to run any mosaic locally and produce json metrics for triage (owner: Tools)
Document mosaics, anchors, and triage runbook in Confluence and link to dashboards (owner: Docs)
Add small quick-check mosaic to PR presubmit with reduced sample size and conservative thresholds (owner: CI)
Postmortem template for CI failures to capture kernel/attention changes and candidate PR refs (owner: Reliability)
Plan follow-up: automated golden rebaseline flow guarded by review and smoke checks (owner: Product)
